entries.desc: Run a local document/capability audit that classifies each frozen DoD capability as implemented, partial, future, or missing, and confirm the output cites the relevant docs and source/status evidence for every classification instead of collapsing partial/future/missing into one bucket.

evidence.note: Frozen capability audit table classifies lifecycle-control capabilities as implemented, partial, future, or unavailable/missing with source/status evidence.

entries.desc: Verify partially implemented capabilities remain marked partial when status commands expose some but not all required enforcement evidence, especially proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup.

evidence.note: Capability status reports proofM7Enforcement=partial, queueCleanupEnforcement=partial, tierCCleanup=future while legacy booleans remain false.

entries.desc: Reject an audit that treats command existence or zero exit status alone as implementation proof; evidence must include capability state, enforcement/readiness status, and source or doc references for the claim.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts command existence is insufficient: capability rows carry statuses/evidence and enforcement booleans stay false.

entries.desc: Run global_control_status as JSON and verify status reporting names the documented control-plane capabilities with accurate implemented, partial, unavailable, or future states, including proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup.

evidence.note: global_control_status exposes implemented/partial/future capability rows and capabilityStatus fields for proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup.

entries.desc: Confirm status reporting stays reconciliation-only: proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup may show partial or unavailable without implying CHK-004 hard-blocks, CHK-005 queue mutation guard, or CHK-006 admissibility enforcement have been completed.

evidence.note: Smoke proves status reconciliation remains reporting-only: proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup booleans are not enabled by projection.

entries.desc: Fail the item if global_control_status overclaims future or unavailable capabilities as enabled, or if dashboard/projection output hides documented gaps that remain open in the frozen DoD audit.

evidence.note: Output keeps future/unavailable work visible instead of hiding documented gaps or overclaiming runtime/proof/queue implementation.

entries.desc: Run queue_governance_status and verify Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification stories are grouped as experiment-batch-exception instead of ordinary duplicate-candidate records.

evidence.note: queue_governance_status groups 23 Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification stories as experiment-batch-exception with migration-title-prefix source.

entries.desc: Verify malformed or incomplete Tier-C experiment records remain cleanup-required and are reported separately from valid experiment-batch-exception groups.

evidence.note: Malformed Tier-C records B-cb7e and B-dbdc remain cleanup-required and separate from the preserved experiment batch.

entries.desc: Prove the experiment exception does not waive lifecycle readiness by checking lifecycle/control status still reports readiness blockers when malformed records or other required gates remain unresolved.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts experiment-batch exceptions preserve evidence only and do not waive lifecycle readiness or set readyForNextSafeAction.

entries.desc: Run runtime closure checks and smoke tasks to prove configured hard-blocks prevent unsafe operations for wrong authoritative cwd, stale active locks, dirty phase-advance state, and worktree authority drift.

evidence.note: Smoke proves enforce mode blocks wrong authoritative cwd, direct main mirror/worktree authority drift, stale active locks, and treats dirty phase-advance state as material when configured.

entries.desc: Verify rollback or config disablement is documented and observable, so each hard-block can be traced to its configured rollout state without masking read-only diagnostics.

evidence.note: Runtime enforcement rollout documents lifecycleControl.runtimeEnforcement warn/enforce/unavailable modes, observable status, and rollback to warn mode.

entries.desc: Fail if any unsafe closure case is only reported as advisory/read-only after rollout is configured, or if worktree authority drift can proceed without an explicit blocking result and reviewable rollback path.

evidence.note: Story-scoped runtime_closure_status is observable for B-cd3a, and smoke rejects unsafe enforce-mode closure cases instead of leaving them advisory-only.

entries.desc: Run queue governance status and lifecycle orchestration smoke to prove duplicate or superseded queue mutations require reviewable mutation evidence before they can change queue state.

evidence.note: Queue governance reports duplicateCandidate=0 for preserved Tier-C experiment stories while still surfacing active worktrees and cleanup-required rows for review.

entries.desc: Verify valid experiment batches and their evidence are preserved when the guard reports duplicate, superseded, or malformed records, and that malformed experiment records remain visible for cleanup.

evidence.note: Valid experiment batches keep cleanupPolicy=preserve and malformed experiment records remain visible as cleanup-required without deleting evidence.

entries.desc: Fail if the mutation guard destroys experiment evidence, silently rewrites duplicate or superseded records, or treats queue governance success as lifecycle completion readiness.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts queue exception success cannot grant readyForNextSafeAction or lifecycle completion readiness.
